goal: Login network restyle (two-tone nodes), Sora site-wide, fitFocused null guard app/layout.tsx app/globals.css components/map/SocialGraph.tsx
summary: Login/signup backdrop (components/auth/PreviewGraph.tsx) keeps its original 34-node 3D node-and-edge network (same seeded layout, edges, sizes, placement) but nodes are now flat two-tone discs like the map: ring = a community color, fill = a personal color (both from lib/colors HUES swatches, the light-theme palette since the login is always cream), soft shadow + paper rim. Motion: two-sine smooth drift, slower yaw (0.07 rad/s), gentle pitch sway instead of continuous tumbling, drag tilt clamped. Register step keeps the zoom/grow/gold ring and adds a gravity bounce with landing squash on the chosen node. Respects prefers-reduced-motion (static). A liquid-bubble version was tried and rejected by the human. Sora replaces Inter + Space Grotesk site-wide: next/font in app/layout.tsx (--font-sora), globals.css --font-sans and --font-heading, and the map canvas reads --font-sora. fitFocused in SocialGraph now returns early when force-graph's getGraphBbox is null (race right after the map mounts) instead of crashing; holdCamera moved after the check.

decisions.what: No four-node loading animation exists in the repo (only the 'Mapping the room...' text), so only the font applies there
decisions.why: The brief described a loader that isn't on any branch.
The brief expected an existing bounce; none existed. Added a restrained gravity hop; drop it if unwanted.

decisions.what: Human asked: no further edits to the homepage map beyond the font and the crash guard
decisions.why: Explicit instruction after reviewing the font.

verification.manual: In-memory demo: login and signup before/after screenshots; desktop and phone-width login layouts unchanged; network animates with ?motion=1 (this machine has reduce-motion on, so by default it's static); map renders in Sora; after the guard, opening the map after sign-in shows no error and settles into the normal fit.
